notes.title: Feather Party - New Mini-Games
notes.notes:
[h1]Two exciting new maps have been added to Feather Party! !
[/h1]

[h2]🕰️ Tick-Tock Terror[/h2]

A random player starts with a bomb.
They must try to blow up other players before the timer runs out.
If they fail, they get eliminated. If they succeed, the bomb is passed to another random player.
The last player standing wins!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/142b0eca7f4bd2f9d603831f30ab51dac0cfcf09.gif[/img]

[h2]🎲 Rolling Dice[/h2]

Giant colorful dice move randomly across the map.
More dice spawn over time!
Players caught under the dice get eliminated.
The last player standing wins!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/14b89591615b5b4a469f7d0fe5c4d5988b6b1889.gif[/img]

[h2]Treadmill Tumble Mini-Game Update![/h2]

Thanks to your feedback, we’ve made improvements to the mechanics of the Treadmill Tumble mini-game. Expect smoother gameplay, better balance, and even more fun moments!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/f32037eac8ffa02468b78282fe2254e95d16d185.gif[/img]

🎮 Jump in now and try out the new maps! 🚀 Plus, don’t miss the 20% discount

notes.title: New Mini-Games and Board Game Mode Update!
notes.notes:
[h1]New Features and Improvements
[/h1]
🎉 New Maps are here in our game! In this update, we’re bringing you two exciting new maps to spice up the gameplay

❄️ Icy Showdown: Try to stay on your feet as you dodge crabs thrown at you on a slippery surface!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/b398fcc10f2cd3460054459ddebec1a8e9c9687c.png[/img]
🏃‍♂️ Treadmill Tumble: Press the correct button within the given time to stay in the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/6de0229c21e422d49174fd2d104272c0de051a00.png[/img]
🃏 [b]Thief Card[/b]

A new strategic card that lets you steal a random card from a chosen player’s deck is now available!

💸[b] Bankruptcy Card[/b]

If your money drops below zero, this penalty card is added to your deck. It activates the second time you go below zero and sends you to jail!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/c49f8735c9944b728483fee44496b46def2d07a1.gif[/img]

🛍️ [b]Membership Card[/b]

A passive card that applies a 70% discount  on your first purchase at the store is now in the game.

📊 [b]Property Panel[/b]

Players’ property count, types, and plunder status can now be viewed when pressing the Tab key.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/86b99971bdfd2c385a257aad5f9be53d60549848.png[/img]

🎮 [b]Mini-Game Frequency[/b]

Added an option in the settings to adjust the frequency of mini-games in Board Game mode e.g., every 2 turns, every 3 turns. Additionally, the interface now displays how many turns remain until the next mini-game.

[b]⏱️ Ready Mode Option
[/b]
After mini-games, the game will not return to the board until a specified number of players mark themselves as ready.

🗂️ [b]Mini-Game Selection List[/b]

Added the ability to select which mini-games can be played in Board Game mode from a list.

🏃‍♀️ [b]Speed Settings
[/b]
Added options to increase character speed to 1x, 2x, or 3x. The default speed has been set to 2x, which means character speed has increased by default.

⏳ [b]Countdown and Sound Alerts
[/b]
A countdown that grows and shrinks and plays a sound alert near the end of the timer in Board Game mode has been added.

[h2]🔧 Bug Fixes[/h2]

♻️ [b]Rewrite Card[/b]

Fixed a bug where the Rewrite card would prevent returning to the main target.

🎮Dive into Feather Party and explore the latest mini-games, strategic cards, and gameplay options.

notes.title: Board Game Mode Updated
notes.notes:
[h1]New Features & Improvements[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/dec1accc4c8c58de8e1efd50519748615a320092.png[/img]

🎄 [b]Snowfall on the Lobby Island[/b]
Feel the holiday spirit with snowy weather and festive light decorations!

🥚 [b]Egg Shuffler Card[/b]
The Egg Shuffler card is here! Relocate the egg to reshape your strategy.

📍 [b]New Egg Nest Locations[/b]
Eggs can now be relocated to more diverse spots across the map.

🦜 [b]Big Bird Rebellion[/b]
When a player becomes the Big Bird, they can now refuse to pay rent.

When buying multiple cards, they will now appear all at once instead of one by one.

⚙️ [b]Mini-Game Transitions[/b]
Improved transitions to address black screen issues, ensuring smoother gameplay flow.

⚖️ [b]Card Balancing[/b]
Card pools have been adjusted, making the game more balanced, especially for the Roadblock Card.


[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

🔧 Ready Status Fixed: Resolved issues with players' ready state during mini-game transitions.
🔧 Splash Screen Issue: Fixed a bug where the game would get stuck on the splash screen at startup.

Discover the new features of Feather Party and share your feedback with us! 💌

notes.title: Release Notes v.0.1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone 👋 ! We've made a new update to [b] Feather Party [/b] and further improved the Board Game mode by considering your feedback. Here are the [b] new features [/b] waiting for you:

[h2] Map and Game Improvements [/h2]
[list] 
[img] {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/ccfb53e38792027a6c44c56622e6f63adb4236fb.png [/img]

[*] 🗺️✨ We want cards to be used more frequently in the game. To achieve this, we added the ability to purchase multiple cards each time you visit the Card Shop in Board Game mode. Additionally, we created a setting that can be adjusted while creating the lobby. This way, depending on the setting you choose while setting up the lobby, it is now possible to purchase 3, 2, or 1 card each time you visit the shop.

[img] {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/58a0ca11d0e674499fd8842a936779f4ba1165a8.png [/img]
[*] In Board Game mode, all players could see the cards purchased from the shop. Again, based on your request, a new setting has been added that allows you to hide these cards from other players.

[*] Profile frames showing the loading status of all players have been added to the return screen from Mini-games in Board Game mode. This way, if one of the players is experiencing a connection issue, it will be easier for us to notice.

[*] A button has been assigned for the Map in Board Game mode. We noticed that sometimes players struggled to roll the dice after viewing the map. Thanks to this setting, there will no longer be any confusion during dice rolls, and the dice roll button will now remain fixed no matter what you did before :)

[*] The Board Game details panel in the Pause Menu has been improved.

[*] The drop rates of certain cards in Board Game have been updated.

[*] System optimizations have been made at the end of Mini-games in Board Game mode.
[/list]
[h2] Bug Fixes [/h2]
[list]
[*] 🔧🐞 We found and fixed a minor bug that allowed players to use a card immediately after rolling the dice or when it wasn't their turn.

[*] A bug that allowed a setting in the lobby settings panel to still be controllable after exiting the panel has been fixed.

[*] A bug that caused the game to freeze if a player who won a bonus egg at the end of Board Game mode left the game has been fixed.
[/list]
Try the new update now and enjoy the improved Board Game mode! 🎉🕹️

#FeatherParty #BoardGameMode #MiniUpdate

notes.title: Board Game Mode Now in Our Game!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/43307acd806a27db1222dd2e519580e08f23f76a.png[/img]

Hello Everyone,

Our long-awaited Board Game Mode is finally complete!
In this new mode, brand-new mechanics, unique gameplay features, and a competitive experience await you!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/fff45fb818f7c4c2f76ef5e72f4ebb14717be076.gif[/img]
[h2]Collect Properties[/h2]
In our game, you’ll find many tiles to explore. On these tiles, you can purchase properties, and upgrade them. If you manage to purchase all properties within the same color you will link them, which results in more profit, extra eggs, and rental income. If you bring all properties of the same color to the max level, you’ll earn an additional egg! When a player lands on a tile owned by another player, they must pay rent in feathers, with the amount varying according to the property's level.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/1ac9c9555e13bcdaab057e09b9afcc1863e6e8b9.gif[/img]
[h2]Try your luck[/h2]
Shop Tile allows players to purchase cards from the card pool to gain a strategic advantage. These cards serve a variety of purposes, from defending your properties to blocking opponents to triggering special events.
When you land on the Chance Tile, a randomly drawn card can bring good fortune or bad. Some cards activate immediately, while others can be saved for the perfect strategic moment.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/0fe3c838d6bc768cb45ef0ca87d6058a55093b55.gif[/img]
[h2]Surprise eggs[/h2]
You can enable Bonus Eggs in the game settings to make the endgame more exciting and competitive. On the game end screen, you can view detailed scores, bonuses, and mini-game results.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/4721da2b421565d295b73ff4f04b85d0b3e55e47.gif[/img]
[h2]Mini Games[/h2]
Our game mode offers two different gameplay options: with and without mini-games.With mini-games enabled, players earn feathers based on their rankings after each mini-game. In the mode without mini-games, a certain amount of feathers is distributed equally among all players.

[b]You can try out this new game mode with your friends now![/b]

notes.title: Release Notes v.0.0.11.7
notes.notes:
We're excited to share some exciting [b]new features and improvements[/b] in our latest update! In [b]"Track Race,"[/b] we've introduced a [b]rear-view camera[/b] for better maneuvering and a revamped player ranking display. For golf enthusiasts,[b] "Mini-Golf"[/b] now includes [b]three new courses[/b]. [b]"Ball Fight"[/b] gets more dynamic with moving platforms, and we've made significant audio and visual enhancements across various modes. Additionally, "Host Migration" now has an exit button, offering more flexibility for players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/789a1365e4fb2203a2d75a674340b747965be672.png[/img]

We've also added a thrilling new feature in[b] "Ball Fight,"[/b] where platforms now move up and down dynamically after a certain period, making gameplay even more challenging and exciting.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/dec0da79ceaeec85c38209294ca2d6e4f4d0ef04.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/dec0da79ceaeec85c38209294ca2d6e4f4d0ef04.gif[/img][/url]

Check out the [b]detailed notes[/b] below for a complete changelog:

[h2]New Features & Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Mini-Golf:[/b] Added 3 new golf courses.
[*][b]Ball Fight:[/b] Platforms now move up and down dynamically after a certain time during the game.
[*][b]Ball Fight:[/b] Balancing adjustments.
[*][b]Track Race:[/b] The player ranking list has been changed from a text box to a standard format with images and icons.
[*][b]Track Race:[/b] Added a rear-view camera (hold C key) to switch to a fixed camera showing the rear view.
[*][b]Track Race:[/b] Vehicle physics improvements (using the handbrake no longer slows the car) 
[*][b]Track Race:[/b] Reduced the time for the camera to recenter.
[*][b]Host Migration:[/b] Added a cancel button to Host Migration, allowing non-host players to leave during the loading screen.
[*][b]Mini-Football:[/b] Increased speed of the Flaming Ball.
[*][b]Mine Sweeper:[/b] Removed excessive flashing lights during color mixing to prevent epilepsy triggers.
[*][b]Water Shader:[/b] Made some optimizations and visual changes.
[*]Audio stops playing when the game is not in focus.
updated to turn off lights during mixing and reveal new colors afterward.
[*]Added vehicle controls to the Keybinding section.
[*]Audio stops playing when the game is not in focus.
[*]Reduced saturation and vibrance of grass colors game-wide.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with character movement keys (forward, backward, left, right) not working in keybindings.
[*]The game now ends automatically and awards XP correctly if the host is left alone after Host Migration.
[*]Prevented non-host players from using the switch buttons between Private/Party modes in the lobby.
[/list]

notes.title: What is next on Feather Party?
notes.notes:
As you know, we are working hard to keep the game [b]balanced[/b]. We are also [b]listening to our community[/b], adding [b]new features[/b], and solving major and minor [b]bugs[/b] along the way. We have [b]limited resources[/b] as an indie game company, so we plan very carefully. Today, we wanted to share a section of our high-level planning for Feather Party. 🐤

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/ace8068ca0917ab654b35d2ad42c51e60926bdcb.png[/img]

Over the [b]next year[/b], we aim to have a total of [b]30 mini-games[/b] in our game. To reach this goal, we will add many [b]new features[/b] and content. We are not sharing which mini-games these will be just yet, but we are working on many interesting [b]game modes[/b]. 🐣

[h3]Board Game Mode[/h3]
Additionally, we are also working on adding a Board Game mode to the game [b]very soon[/b]. This new mode will offer our players a different experience and increase the game's variety. 🎲

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/4a63d1ca4dc80efd0102a14e013d29d876ecec37.png[/img]

notes.title: Release Notes v.0.0.11.6
notes.notes:
Hello Feather Party players!

In this update, we focused on addressing the issues you've reported and improving the overall game experience based on your feedback. Here are the details:

[h2] New Ball Physics System [/h2]
Ball physics was one of the top complaints we received, so we completely revamped the ball physics system! You can perform lofted and precise shots with the attack button, and make more powerful shots with the Dash button. Normal touches now provide a more minimal and controllable dribbling experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/20a7839846037d602b0c2622d650f20066955369.gif[/img]

[h2]Rainy and Sunny Weather Conditions[/h2]
Now, rainy and sunny weather conditions will appear randomly in our games! You might even encounter thunderstorms occasionally. Currently available in Mini-Football, Cannon Island, and Spotlight maps. These dynamic weather changes will add new excitement to your gameplay!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/1404f14bdb73e4bca521aecd49b1abe6dc553c84.gif[/img]

[h2] Map and Game Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Spotlight:[/b] We updated the game map with changes and visual enhancements to make gameplay easier.
[*][b]Balloon Rush:[/b] We updated the game map to make gameplay easier.
[*][b]Mini-Golf:[/b] We made updates to make gameplay easier on the maps. We added the Reset/Respawn function. You can now teleport to the Checkpoint area by pressing a button.
[*][b]Feather Catch:[/b] The issue of losing feathers if you use Dash has been removed.
[*][b]Lobby Management / Player Kick:[/b] We updated the Player Kick panel.
[*][b]Lobby Settings:[/b] We added the "NEW" label above the newly added games listed in the lobby settings.
[*][b]Game Logo:[/b] We added the early access text above the game logo.
[*][b]Feedback Button:[/b] We updated the areas where the feedback button should and should not be visible.
[/list]

[h2] Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Track Race:[/b] The bug that allowed Nitro to be used while going in reverse has been fixed.
[*][b]Falling Blocks:[/b] The issue of gliding outside the map and getting stuck in walls or climbing to an upper block has been fixed.
[/list]

With this update, we aim to make your gaming experience smoother. Your feedback and responses are very valuable to us. Keep playing and keep sharing your fun!

notes.title: Host Migration
notes.notes:
Hello Feather Party players!

In this update, we have brought you long-awaited new features and improvements. Here are the details:

[h2]Host Migration System[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/efffe6089f9fdcfb970ecd3e0b9dd8d1683a7202.gif[/img]
One of the biggest complaints from our players was that if the [b]host[/b] left the game, the game would be interrupted. For example, if the host saw their score was too low, they might hit [b]Alt+F4[/b] and disappear, causing the other players in the lobby to disconnect and their game to close. This will no longer be the case! With the [b]new Host Migration system[/b], if the host leaves the game, the game will not end and the host role will automatically transfer to another player. Your gaming experience will never be interrupted again! 🎉

With this new feature, if the game is closed while results are being calculated, it will continue to show the [b]results[/b]. If the current [b]mini-game[/b] is not finished, it will [b]replay[/b] it, and if it is finished, it will move to the [b]next one[/b]. This will make your games more seamless and fun! 
 [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/26e60c08682114adff4048177f4a0797e1866947.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/8db7fd0fa33abfc67d8cefc20994177460325a6b.png[/img][/url] [h3]Crab Teammate[/h3]
A crab will be assigned to the missing team in Tile Takeover and Mini-Football games. It will paint tiles in [b]Tile Takeover[/b] and act as a goalie in [b]Mini-Football[/b]. Your crab buddy is always there to boost team spirit!

[h3]NEW Mini-Game: [b]Track Race[/b] [/h3]
Our brand-new [b]Track Race[/b] mini-game is now available! We have redesigned the car physics and added a system where you can earn [b]nitro by drifting[/b]. With random obstacles (cones) appearing on the map, races have become more exciting. Different track variations will be added in the next stage, so stay tuned!

[h3]Lobby Island and Other Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] The mandatory start system on the [b]Lobby Island[/b] has been gradually updated. Now, even a single player can start the game if they enter the start area and are willing to wait long enough.
[*] The system in the [b]Rollerball[/b] (sphere) mode has been changed and improved.
[*] The issue of the environment and the central player's image being [b]shaky[/b] during camera rotations has been improved.
[*] Waiting times between [b]scene transitions[/b] have been improved.
[*] Some missing [b]localizations[/b] have been completed.[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The bug where users could not return to the lobby and got stuck on the loading screen has been fixed.
[*] The bug where the timer reset to [b]30 seconds[/b] when someone left the Preparation Area at the last second has been fixed.
[*] The bug that made characters appear stuck in games following the [b]Ball Fight[/b] mode has been fixed.
[*] The bug where players did not have physical reactions to other players in the [b]Rollerball[/b] (sphere) mode has been fixed.
[*] Some localization errors have been fixed (French and Indonesian).
[*] The bug where the bonus game incorrectly ran with only one player under certain conditions has been fixed.
[*] The bug where the [b]goals[/b] on the lobby island were positioned incorrectly on the scoreboard has been fixed.
[*] The bug where [b]particle effects[/b] on the lobby island conflicted with 3D screens has been fixed.
[*] The bug where mini-games that ended in a tie were not listed in the game end maps section has been fixed.
[/list]

Have fun! 🦀🚗🎮
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/26e60c08682114adff4048177f4a0797e1866947.png[/img]

notes.title: Board Game mode Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are continuing to work diligently on our Board Game mode. We're exploring various game mechanics to create a mode that perfectly suits the characters of our little chicks.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/e432b7fee176991750468404332d14b59a49c1fa.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/bee281044bf88df3e7ee2f10655215a9b5fe60cf.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Alongside these efforts, this update focuses primarily on addressing [b]your requests[/b]. Let’s dive into the details:[/h3]

[b]Player Kicking:[/b]
One of the most requested features was the player-kicking system. Yes, you can now kick players who enter your room without permission or who do not follow the rules you set for your lobby. The lobby owner can now kick other chicks from the room before starting the game, while on the lobby island. Access this new panel, which allows you to kick unwanted chicks, via the "Manage" button in the pause menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/8fe5326b60e2a0f2a4b1567795d938b2dacd4ad6.png[/img]

[b]New Scoring System:[/b]
Players who prefer to play Feather Party with 3 or 4 players instead of the maximum number requested a change to the current scoring system. We've added a new scoring system for them. With this system, you can now toggle Ranking Rewards on and off. If the lobby owner turns off the ranking rewards, no points are awarded to the 2nd and 3rd players at the end of the game, making the competition fairer in smaller groups.

[b]Falling Blocks Bug Fix:
[/b]Mischievous chicks found a bug in the Falling Blocks game where they could jump onto the water and then fly sideways to a surface inside, causing them to hang in the air. This exploit, which many players reported and we noticed, leading to unfair scoring, has now been fixed.

[b]Lobby Owner Leaving the Game:[/b]
We received numerous complaints about situations where the lobby owner left the game before it ended. We understand how frustrating this can be. We are working on a feature that transfers lobby ownership to another player in the lobby and allows the game to continue from where it left off. However, this will take some time to complete. For now, we have made a small improvement: when the lobby owner leaves, the end-game screen will now appear, showing the score distribution and details of the games played up to that point to all players before the game closes.

[b]Quick Play Mode is Back:[/b]
We have reopened our Quick Play mode, which we had to close for a while due to a bug.

[b]Game Durations Shortened:[/b]
Many of our players reported that the durations of our mini-games were too long. We reviewed the durations and scoring of all our games in detail. We have reduced the durations of many mini-games as follows. Additionally, in Ice Hockey, we no longer have a goal limit. The match continues until the end of the game time.
[list]
[*] [b]Balloon Rush:[/b] Game duration reduced from 150 seconds to 120 seconds.
[*] [b]Count Master:[/b] Game duration reduced from 150 seconds to 120 seconds.
[*] [b]Feather Catch: [/b]Game duration reduced from 120 seconds to 90 seconds.
[*] [b]Ice Hockey:[/b] Game duration reduced from 240 seconds to 150 seconds. The end condition changed from a 3-goal limit to the maximum goals scored within the time limit.
[*] [b]Mini Football:[/b] Game duration reduced from 240 seconds to 150 seconds.
[*] [b]Mini Golf:[/b] Game duration reduced from 240 seconds to 210 seconds.
[*] [b]Spotlight:[/b] Game duration reduced from 120 seconds to 90 seconds.
[*] [b]Tile Takeover: [/b]Game duration reduced from 120 seconds to 105 seconds.
[/list] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/32e51ead59a1718d0138d10a825fd071d6bf43bd.png]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/c50241c9acebf11a39aba7ee1433f016cdd9b931.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/327dcc7deaf83cb1627416a85bff355eb117322d.png[/img][/url]

In addition, we also made several [b]improvements and bug fixes[/b]. Let’s quickly list them below:

[list]
[*] Key bindings for Scoreboard, Quick Chat, and Change List Size actions have been added to the settings. You can now assign them to different keys as you wish.
[*] The mandatory start countdown timer has been placed within the "Waiting for Players..." notification.
[*] In the Mini-Football game, the field has been enlarged, goals have been moved outside the field, and balancing has been done.
[*] Fixed an issue where Vertical Synchronization was not applied after resetting settings.
[*] Fixed an issue where players got stuck on the lobby creation screen after being disconnected from a room.
[*] Fixed a visual bug where leaderboard screens overlapped on the lobby island.
[*] Fixed an issue where sound levels were incorrect after scene transitions.
[/list]

notes.title: Release Notes v.0.0.11.3
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

With this update, we added a [b]quick chat menu[/b] to the game. You can access this menu by pressing the[b] R key[/b] and selecting the message you want to say to your teammates. We now have a quick, albeit very simple, [b]chat tool[/b] via this interface with people we do not meet in a Discord channel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/8e9f797163979b16c6e21d2addf913376f10654b.png[/img]

Are there any [b]message examples[/b] you would like to add to this menu? If you have it, you can send it to us [b]directly under this post[/b].

Apart from this update, we also made [b]improvements [/b]to many titles and fixed some [b]bugs[/b]. Let's briefly summarize them now:

[list]
[*] The player-level system has been balanced.

[*] Added [b]region sorting[/b] for the browser. You can choose from 3 different options. You can filter it: [b]Worldwide - Far - Close[/b]

[*] Improvements have been made to [b]filters [/b]in the browser to show more accurate results.

[*] It has been fixed that people using [b]CapsLock [/b]will see an [b]unknown key[/b] as an image when assigning keys.

[*] [b]Name and level display[/b] has been added to the pause screen so that players can easily see their levels.

[*] When the player list in the top left is expanded, it remains fixed and does not shrink again.

[*] [b]The waiting time[/b] at the end of the maps of games played with [b]Ready Mode [/b]has been reduced.

[*] The default target score in [b]Party Mode[/b] has been changed to [b]15[/b].

[*] An improvement has been made to ensure that the sounds do not decrease inconsistently when adjusting the [b]sound levels[/b] in the settings.

[*] Fixed the control keys being displayed as different types of gamepads when playing with a [b]gamepad[/b].

[*] Fixed the icon of living people appearing [b]dead on the scoreboard screen[/b].

[*] Fixed a bug that sometimes caused players to fly up in[b] Ball Fight [/b]mode.

[*] Fixed the bug that caused some users to be kicked out of the lobby in [b]Ball Fight [/b]mode.

[*] Fixed the bug that caused users to get double points in[b] Mini Golf [/b]mode.

[*] Fixed the issue where the texts at the bottom right giving the type information of the mini-games in the [b]Lobby Settings window[/b] appear intertwined.

[*] Fixed the issue where [b]assigned keys[/b] would be reset after assigning keys from the settings screen.

[*] Fixed issue where chicks entering the area immediately after the electricity visual disappears in [b]Spotlight Mode[/b] would be electrocuted.

[*] Physics improvements have been made in [b]Mini Football and Ice Hockey[/b] mode
[/list]

notes.title: Board Game mode Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We continue to work tirelessly on our board game mode. We are working on many different game mechanics to publish a board game mode that fits the characters of our little chicks.

With the release of Feather Party, we continue to develop many new feature requests you asked for and fix many bugs you reported. Let's now look at the details of these titles with this update:

[list]
[*] Yes, we know that our little chicks love the lobby island and want to spend a long time there. Sometimes we witness that players get too caught up in the mini-games on the lobby island :) For this reason, when one of the players enters the Ready Area to start the game, we added a notification so that all other players on the Lobby island see this. However, it is of course still up to them if they want to join them in the Ready Area ;)

[*] A lot of fights could break out when we tried to fit our little chicks into a narrow space. Although this can be very enjoyable at times :D we have seen that it can cause some discomfort to the players before the full game starts. For this reason, we prevented players from pushing each other in the Ready Area.

[*] We detected and fixed a bug that prevented lobbies from being listed. The lobby listing system has been changed and the lobby search feature has been improved.

[*] Many of our players have reported that there is a vulnerability that allows outside access to rooms that are in the type of Invite only. We have implemented an interim solution that solves this quickly. Now, when you open an invitation-only room, others can not enter your room. We continue to work to solve this problem more permanently.

[*] We added 2 new Mini Golf maps. Now we have a total of 8 different mini-golf maps in the game. 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/32e51ead59a1718d0138d10a825fd071d6bf43bd.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/a9f7daa307ef2fe07931d6cbbe9aacea37e99773.png[/img][/url]

[*] Fixed version mismatch error caused by version control.
 
[*] The vulnerability that could change the size and color of Steam usernames appearing in the game with text commands written to Steam usernames has been fixed.

[*] Fixed the bug where the Scoreboard remained open on the screen and could not be closed.

[*] Fixed the timer not continuing at the end of the mini-game.

[*] Fixed the character not being able to settle in the Flappy Feather and Personalization area when entering it.

[*] Fixed the bug that caused the player to rise to the sky in Ball Fight mode.

[*] Fixed the character's movements being locked after Dashing.

[*] Fixed incorrect entry in login panel with code.

[*] Fixed game crashing when listing lobbies.

[*] Fixed the issue of getting stuck on the loading screen when first entering the lobby and spawning underwater.

[*] Fixed the issue of not connecting back to the room when returning to the lobby at the end of the game.

[*] Fixed the operation of the Q and E keys when Activating in the Profile section.

[*] Fixed the bug that prevented death in Falling Blocks mode.
[/list]

notes.title: Release Notes v.0.0.10.2
notes.notes:
As we are very close to releasing Feather Party in early access, we continue to add [b]new features[/b] to the game. Let's summarize them briefly:

[list]
[*] For players who don't want to quickly move on to the next game between mini-games, we've added a [b]Ready mode[/b]. When you set up the game by turning this mode on, you can't move on to the next game until half of the people in the lobby say ready. In this way, you can take as much break as you want between games.
[*] A [b]new level system[/b] has been added to the game. At the end of each game we play, we earn an [b]experience point[/b] according to our stats in the game.
[*] We want to be able to include players who fall too far behind in the game in the points when they earn points again. For this reason, we have added a mechanic that can give a point bonus to those who are lower in the ranking in the game for a [b]comeback[/b].
[*] Many [b]new faces[/b] have been added to the game, from [b]extremely cute [/b]to [b]very angry[/b], from [b]a little crazy[/b] to [b]tearful[/b] faces.
[*] The visual theme of the [b]Mini Golf[/b] game has been completely revamped.
[*] Rollerball has improved controls and added collision effects.
[*] Improved visuals in Mine Sweeper.
[/list]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/32e51ead59a1718d0138d10a825fd071d6bf43bd.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/a9f7daa307ef2fe07931d6cbbe9aacea37e99773.png[/img][/url]

Many [b]improvements [/b]have also been made with this update. Let's list them now:

[list]
[*] Design changes have been made to the Speedrun section and dock area on Lobby Island.
[*] The end of the map ranking system has been revamped.
[*] The interface of the Lobby Settings panel has been revamped.
[*] Added a frame for the Level bar that shows the cosmetic item that will be unlocked when leveling up.
[*] Added arena shrinking over time in Ball Fight.
[*] Made visual adjustments to Shaky Tiles.
[*] Loading screen transition time has been shortened by over 50%.
[/list]

And of course, we continued to fix many [b]bugs[/b], the most important of which you can see below:

[list]
[*] Fixed incorrect teleporting back to the lobby, stuck loading screen, and camera opening incorrectly.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would start twice as a result of a delayed load when transitioning into the game.
[*] Fixed an issue where other players would not appear after a delayed load when transitioning into the game.
[*] Fixed an issue where the character would spawn with a delay.
[*] Fixed an issue where the score frame would not appear due to the Return Score.
[*] Fixed an issue where the character could move at the end of the game in Ball Fight.
[*] Fixed a bug that would lock the loading screen if a player exits during scene changes.
[/list]
